title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0323
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0323
Privilege Escalation Vulnerability in LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin
Original Issue Date:June      22, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin versions prior to 2.4.8.
Overview
A vulnerability has been reported in LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin which could allow an attacker to gain elevated privileges on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
Web hosting providers, server administrators, and cPanel users managing LiteSpeed-powered shared hosting environments.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of privilege escalation, full server compromise.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for root-level access, server compromise, disruption of hosted services.
Description
LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Plugin is a management plugin that allows users to manage LiteSpeed Web Server features directly through the cPanel interface.
A vulnerability exists in the LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin due to improper handling of user-supplied symlinks links. An attacker with FTP access or web shell access on a shared hosting server running CloudLinux/CageFS could exploit this vulnerability to bypass intended security restrictions.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to gain elevated privileges on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://blog.litespeedtech.com/2026/06/01/security-update-for-litespeed-cpanel-plugin-2/
Vendor Information
LiteSpeed

title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0322
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0322
Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension
Original Issue Date:June      22, 2026
Severity Rating: HIGH
Software Affected
Joomla Content Editor extension versions prior to 2.9.99.5
Overview
A vulnerability has been reported in Joomla Content Editor Extension, which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All end-user organizations and individuals using Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension.
Risk Assessment:
Risk of remote code execution.
Impact Assessment:
Unauthorized access of sensitive data, data manipulation and complete system compromise.
Description
Joomla Content Editor (JCE) Extension is a popular editor extension for Joomla that provides advanced tools for creating and managing website content. It enhances the default Joomla editor with features such as media management, file handling, and rich text editing.
A vulnerability has been reported in Joomla Content Editor Extension due to improper access control within the editor profile management functionality. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading editor profiles and execute arbitrary PHP code on the targeted system.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the targeted system, potentially resulting in complete system compromise.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://www.joomlacontenteditor.net/support/changelog/editor
https://www.joomlacontenteditor.net/news/jce-security-update-and-a-free-patch-for-older-sites
